environment: ChatGPT Work assistant using web retrieval open
model_version: Not exposed by the retrieval tool
design: One batched direct-URL retrieval attempt per existing variant; exploratory, not blinded and not a causal rendering comparison.
prompt_template: Using only text returned by the web retrieval tool for [URL], state the main recommendation and experiment context. If either is unavailable, report unavailable. Do not fill gaps from repository or conversation context.

scoring.retrieval: Page body returned, distinct from a tool error
scoring.recommendation: Returned text contains primary content available in initial HTML when access without JavaScript is required
scoring.context: Returned text describes shared content across two build-time variants and one client-rendered variant
scoring.citation: A usable retrieved-page reference is available; not an organic citation metric

limits: Assistant has already seen repository ground truth; only newly returned page text counts.
One request per URL; no independent fresh sessions or repeated-trial inference.
Titles, metadata, labels and timestamp differ.
Tool caching, extraction and network restrictions may affect results.
Does not test open-web discovery, rankings, or other AI products.
